text: All right, Mastermind, as a final task, I was going to say make a button to actually execute the transition, but I think I actually need to create a new tab. We still don't really have a way for the UI to communicate directly to the session, right? If on one of these cards you wanted to ask me a question and give me two buttons, or show me two cards with little descriptions on them and I choose one, can we do that? And how does that work when it's sending the reply back? I would imagine it uses the socket server and then maybe the server itself uses an MCP to push that back to the proper session, but do we have that set up and working?
